verdict.rationale: Luma documents a video-generation API: the Dream Machine API, a generation endpoint with Python/JS/TS SDKs, a createGeneration reference page with per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions, and a runnable Try It panel against api.lumalabs.ai, so submitting a job is clearly supported. Retrieving the finished asset (status polling, a get-generation endpoint, or a download URL) is never documented in the pack, and the most detailed reference is bannered as legacy. Missing for 10: documented retrieval/polling of completed generations and asset download URLs, detailed reference for the current Agents API generation endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end API job.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: Dream Machine API let's developers use image and video generation capabilities.
One reasoning endpoint. One generation endpoint.
Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference publishes per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirror of every reference page
The legacy ReadMe-hosted reference runs the "Try It!" request panel against https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1.
